cost.note: translation is parse+elaborate+emit, linear in the program

notes: The first leg of the C / RISC-V / BTOR2 triangle. prog (T.py): the c interpreter's own front end embedded verbatim, and every elaborated CFG node emitted as a labeled RV64 block ending in `fence`, so a riscv frame is a c frame and bad AND depth carry exactly — a universal claim at riscv bound k is a bound-k fact at the C level, no bound_cap. Slots are .data cells of their own width; expression values are kept canonical (the 64-bit pattern of conv(v, ctype)); the division family, shift saturation, and array guards mirror the interpreter's rules instruction by instruction. obs: identical observable names, maps is the identity. wit (lam_wit.py): frames align, so the carry-back is the renaming \"<n>\" -> \"h<n>\"; corpus 002 exercises it with three inputs of three widths, and both wit mutants fail there. No cert channel: riscv has no certificate schema yet. Pre-admission evidence: the square held on the seven corpus programs and on the 79 svcomp25-mini programs under random frame-addressed stimuli (see the admission-time square_c_riscv record in the notes of the first play).
